Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

PTR - subject to change before Season 15 launches; every 3.2.0 number here comes from a one-week PTR build and Blizzard routinely revises them before release. Season 14's Rogue meta build carries forward essentially intact, which is itself the finding: Rogue is the only class near the top that took no meaningful nerf in 3.2.0. Two changes make it better rather than merely unhurt. Nilfur's Narrow Eye's 5-piece now increases Marksman skill range, which is a direct buff to a skill whose entire value is how many enemies one shot can line up. And the new Tricks of the Trade paragon node grants 20%[x] increased damage for each of Marksman, Cutthroat, Mobility and Trap skills on the bar - Penetrating Shot and Forceful Arrow cover Marksman, Dash covers Mobility, and Smoke Grenade covers Trap, so the standard bar already banks three of the four multipliers without changing a thing. Aspect of Poisonous Clouds additionally now makes Poisoned enemies deal 7-10%[x] reduced damage, which is free defence for the Poison variant specifically. Marked adjusted rather than unchanged because the paragon route and one talisman value genuinely move.

Rotation
  1. Lead every pack with Shadow Clone, Smoke Grenade before the shot for the Trap multiplier and the Vulnerable setup, then Penetrating Shot down the line.
  2. Keep Poison Imbuement up by attacking, Dash out of danger rather than through it, and fight with a wall behind the pack so the arrow bounces back through it.
Variants

Leveling — Poison Imbuement up, Forceful Arrow to refill Energy, then Penetrating Shot down the longest line of enemies you can find. Dash between packs. Shadow Clone on every elite.
Move on when Level 70 with Torment 1 unlocked, and Aspect of Imitated Imbuement in hand.

Early Endgame — Keep Poison Imbuement up by hitting things, not by waiting on the cooldown. Shadow Clone for the damage window and the Vulnerable application. Smoke Grenade into the pack before the shot. Dash between packs to stack Ferocity. Penetrating Shot continuously down enemy lines. Talisman at this stage: Spellbound Steel, which applies Shadow Imbuement while you progress toward the real set.
Move on when The Sightless Set assembled - once Shadow Clone starts resetting rapidly the rotation changes character entirely.

Late Endgame — With the Sightless Set online, Shadow Clone comes back almost immediately - lead every pack with it rather than saving it. Poison Imbuement is maintained by attacking. Smoke Grenade before the shot for the Trap multiplier and the Vulnerable setup. Nilfur's Narrow Eye's 5-piece now extends Marksman range on the PTR, so lines you could not previously reach through are worth taking.
Move on when Eaglehorn equipped and the Sightless Set complete - at that point start Pit and Tower pushing rather than farming.

Pushing — Positioning is still the build. Fight with a wall behind or beside the pack so Eaglehorn's arrow bounces back through it for a second hit - Maxroll lists 'requires good positioning' as this build's stated downside and at push tiers that is where clear time is won or lost. The PTR's extended Marksman range makes some of those angles easier, not automatic. Shadow Clone on cooldown, Poison Imbuement maintained by attacking, Dash out of danger rather than through it. Everything above describes the 3.2.0 PTR build and may change before Season 15 launches.

Stat requirements
  • [ptr] Aim for 70% Critical Strike Chance on your character sheet while in town.
  • [ptr] You only need 50% Attack Speed Bonus on gear, since 10 stacks of Ferocity grant another 50%.

PTR status: reused verbatim from the verified Season 14 Rogue build - diablo4lootfilter.com/filters was confirmed reachable on 2026-08-08 while diablofilter.com/browse returned HTTP 403 twice and remains unreachable. No Season 15 filter exists yet because community filters are written against live patches. Search class Rogue, build Penetrating Shot, endgame strictness. The Season 14 code is close to correct for this build since the gear list barely moves, but it will not know about Soul Splinters or the nine Legacy Uniques - unhide jewelry before importing.

Uniques
  • weapon PTR route: PTR Boosts from the vendor Mrak next to the main Waypoint in any major city - his boosts include random uniques and maxed aspects. Live route as of Season 14, which 3.2.0 does not change: target-farm Echo of Varshan at Initiate lair tier (1 Lair Key, Torment 1+), then upgrade it. On 3.2.0 the upgrade path improved - the Horadric Cube's 'Upgrade Direct Item to Mythic' now transfers your rolled affixes 1:1 rather than rerolling them, so roll the bow you want first and convert second. Where →
  • offhand PTR route: Mrak's PTR Boosts. Live route: target-farm Harbinger of Hatred at Greater Lair tier (1 Greater Lair Key). Where →
  • helm Mythic Unique, all classes. PTR route: Mrak's PTR Boosts. Live route: no dedicated boss - on 3.2.0 craft it at the Jeweler from Resplendent Sparks and Runes choosing the helm slot, which carries no Crafted tag and so does not consume your one crafted-Mythic slot; or take it from a Blacksmith Mythic cache; or drop it from any boss. It kept the Season 14 rework to +6 to all skills. Where →
  • gloves PTR route: Mrak's PTR Boosts. Live route: no dedicated boss - farm via the Horadric Cube 'Upgrade to Unique' recipe (Common gloves plus 1 Enhanced Primordial Dust and 10 Primordial Dust). Where →
  • chest PTR route: Mrak's PTR Boosts. Live route: target-farm Harbinger of Hatred at Greater Lair tier (1 Greater Lair Key). Where →
  • amulet PTR route: Mrak's PTR Boosts. Live route: unpublished for 3.2.0; it exists in Season 14's general unique pool. Newly worth chasing on the PTR - its damage bonus doubled from 7.5-10%[x] to 15-20%[x], which moves it from a filler unique to a real amulet contender. Where →
  • SSplinter of Anguish jewelry socket New Soul Splinter socketable, jewelry only. PTR route: Mrak's PTR Boosts explicitly include Soul Splinters. Live route: unpublished. Anguish is the correct pick here and Splinter of Hellfire is disqualified: Hellfire's 40-100% increased damage costs 100% Critical Strike Chance, and this build's whole damage model is critical strikes on a piercing shot. Anguish's +30% Primary Resource cost is a real problem for a build Maxroll already calls Energy-starved - pair it with extra Energy Regeneration on pants and rings, and drop it if you start stalling mid-pull. Where →
  • Target-farm The Butcher, a Greater-tier Lair boss (1x Greater Lair Key) - the dedicated source for this item. Where →

Point allocation, in order69 points across 11 nodes

[ptr] Provenance, stated plainly. No 3.2.0 skill tree is published for any build on any site - the official notes carry no allocations, and Maxroll, Icy Veins, d4builds and d4guides were all still serving Season 14 guides on 2026-08-08, day 5 of the 8-day PTR. This allocation is therefore the specialist's, built from the skill list the PTR digest authorises for this class plus the 3.2.0 changes that actually apply. Treat the point counts as a starting shape to test, not as a published build. Where a skill's upgrade mods are named below, those names are carried over from Season 14 planner data - 3.2.0 does not rename them. Where a skill appears with no mods, that is deliberate: its mod names were not published anywhere consulted, and inventing them would be worse than leaving them out. On the PTR you can skip this stage - Mrak's boosts grant level 70 and maxed aspects directly - so it is written for a live Season 15. Specialization while levelling is Combo Points; note that there is no Death Trap specialization in this version of the game, only Inner Sight, Preparation and Combo Points.

Skill point priority

  1. Penetrating Shot to max - it is the only damage skill that matters
  2. Forceful Arrow for Energy generation; the build is Energy-hungry from the very start and 3.2.0 does nothing to fix that
  3. Poison Imbuement next - its cooldown shortens as you land hits, so uptime comes from attacking rather than waiting
  4. Dash and Shadow Step for mobility. Note the 3.2.0 rename: Dash's Shadow Play variant is now called Echo. Same skill, new label
  5. Shadow Clone as the ultimate - it applies Vulnerable and Weaken and resets cooldowns

Skill point priority

  1. Penetrating Shot max
  2. Poison Imbuement max - the Poison variant's damage identity
  3. Shadow Clone max: it is the Poison variant's Vulnerable source, a different role than it plays in the Cold variant
  4. Smoke Grenade replaces Concealment on the PTR bar. Two reasons: it banks the Trap category for Tricks of the Trade's 20%[x], and its Shade Grenade variant now gains Combo Point damage and Shade damage bonuses when using Combo Points
  5. Dash for Ferocity stacks, mobility, and the Mobility category on Tricks of the Trade
  6. Inner Sight specialization to help with Energy

Board & glyph focus

The Season 14 route first: Energy regeneration, because this build is genuinely resource-starved and a dry bar costs more DPS than a missing damage node, then crit chance and damage, then Poison nodes. Rank glyphs by running the Pit. [ptr] The change that matters in 3.2.0 is the Tricks of the Trade rework - 20%[x] per skill category, and the bar above covers Marksman (Penetrating Shot, Forceful Arrow), Mobility (Dash) and Trap (Smoke Grenade), so three of four multipliers would be banked. But that node lives on the rogue board of the same name, which this carried-over Season 14 board set does not attach; taking it means a board swap no 3.2.0 source publishes yet. Treat it as the open question of this build, not as a step you can follow today.

How to run them

[ptr] 3.2.0 changes nothing about mercenaries - no mercenary name appears anywhere in the official 3.2.0 notes. This is the Season 14 Poison Penetrating Shot pairing carried over, which is the only guidance that exists. Hire Subo and take Incendiary Bolt, Scorched Earth, Snipe and Molotov; Scorched Earth's roughly 30% increase to your damage-over-time is what makes him the Poison variant's pick over Raheir, who the Cold variant hires instead. Reinforce with Varyana on Bloodthirst, Opportunity trigger Penetrating Shot. Icy Veins reinforces with Raheir/Bastion off Dark Shroud instead; that disagreement predates the PTR and 3.2.0 does nothing to settle it.

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

PTR - subject to change before Season 15 launches; every 3.2.0 number here comes from a one-week PTR build and Blizzard routinely revises them before release. Season 14's Rogue meta build carries forward essentially intact, which is itself the finding: Rogue is the only class near the top that took no meaningful nerf in 3.2.0. Two changes make it better rather than merely unhurt. Nilfur's Narrow Eye's 5-piece now increases Marksman skill range, which is a direct buff to a skill whose entire value is how many enemies one shot can line up. And the new Tricks of the Trade paragon node grants 20%[x] increased damage for each of Marksman, Cutthroat, Mobility and Trap skills on the bar - Penetrating Shot and Forceful Arrow cover Marksman, Dash covers Mobility, and Smoke Grenade covers Trap, so the standard bar already banks three of the four multipliers without changing a thing. Aspect of Poisonous Clouds additionally now makes Poisoned enemies deal 7-10%[x] reduced damage, which is free defence for the Poison variant specifically. Marked adjusted rather than unchanged because the paragon route and one talisman value genuinely move.

Rotation
  1. Lead every pack with Shadow Clone, Smoke Grenade before the shot for the Trap multiplier and the Vulnerable setup, then Penetrating Shot down the line.
  2. Keep Poison Imbuement up by attacking, Dash out of danger rather than through it, and fight with a wall behind the pack so the arrow bounces back through it.
Variants

Leveling — Poison Imbuement up, Forceful Arrow to refill Energy, then Penetrating Shot down the longest line of enemies you can find. Dash between packs. Shadow Clone on every elite.
Move on when Level 70 with Torment 1 unlocked, and Aspect of Imitated Imbuement in hand.

Early Endgame — Keep Poison Imbuement up by hitting things, not by waiting on the cooldown. Shadow Clone for the damage window and the Vulnerable application. Smoke Grenade into the pack before the shot. Dash between packs to stack Ferocity. Penetrating Shot continuously down enemy lines. Talisman at this stage: Spellbound Steel, which applies Shadow Imbuement while you progress toward the real set.
Move on when The Sightless Set assembled - once Shadow Clone starts resetting rapidly the rotation changes character entirely.

Late Endgame — With the Sightless Set online, Shadow Clone comes back almost immediately - lead every pack with it rather than saving it. Poison Imbuement is maintained by attacking. Smoke Grenade before the shot for the Trap multiplier and the Vulnerable setup. Nilfur's Narrow Eye's 5-piece now extends Marksman range on the PTR, so lines you could not previously reach through are worth taking.
Move on when Eaglehorn equipped and the Sightless Set complete - at that point start Pit and Tower pushing rather than farming.

Pushing — Positioning is still the build. Fight with a wall behind or beside the pack so Eaglehorn's arrow bounces back through it for a second hit - Maxroll lists 'requires good positioning' as this build's stated downside and at push tiers that is where clear time is won or lost. The PTR's extended Marksman range makes some of those angles easier, not automatic. Shadow Clone on cooldown, Poison Imbuement maintained by attacking, Dash out of danger rather than through it. Everything above describes the 3.2.0 PTR build and may change before Season 15 launches.

Stat requirements
  • [ptr] Aim for 70% Critical Strike Chance on your character sheet while in town.
  • [ptr] You only need 50% Attack Speed Bonus on gear, since 10 stacks of Ferocity grant another 50%.

PTR status: reused verbatim from the verified Season 14 Rogue build - diablo4lootfilter.com/filters was confirmed reachable on 2026-08-08 while diablofilter.com/browse returned HTTP 403 twice and remains unreachable. No Season 15 filter exists yet because community filters are written against live patches. Search class Rogue, build Penetrating Shot, endgame strictness. The Season 14 code is close to correct for this build since the gear list barely moves, but it will not know about Soul Splinters or the nine Legacy Uniques - unhide jewelry before importing.

Uniques
  • weapon PTR route: PTR Boosts from the vendor Mrak next to the main Waypoint in any major city - his boosts include random uniques and maxed aspects. Live route as of Season 14, which 3.2.0 does not change: target-farm Echo of Varshan at Initiate lair tier (1 Lair Key, Torment 1+), then upgrade it. On 3.2.0 the upgrade path improved - the Horadric Cube's 'Upgrade Direct Item to Mythic' now transfers your rolled affixes 1:1 rather than rerolling them, so roll the bow you want first and convert second. Where →
  • offhand PTR route: Mrak's PTR Boosts. Live route: target-farm Harbinger of Hatred at Greater Lair tier (1 Greater Lair Key). Where →
  • helm Mythic Unique, all classes. PTR route: Mrak's PTR Boosts. Live route: no dedicated boss - on 3.2.0 craft it at the Jeweler from Resplendent Sparks and Runes choosing the helm slot, which carries no Crafted tag and so does not consume your one crafted-Mythic slot; or take it from a Blacksmith Mythic cache; or drop it from any boss. It kept the Season 14 rework to +6 to all skills. Where →
  • gloves PTR route: Mrak's PTR Boosts. Live route: no dedicated boss - farm via the Horadric Cube 'Upgrade to Unique' recipe (Common gloves plus 1 Enhanced Primordial Dust and 10 Primordial Dust). Where →
  • chest PTR route: Mrak's PTR Boosts. Live route: target-farm Harbinger of Hatred at Greater Lair tier (1 Greater Lair Key). Where →
  • amulet PTR route: Mrak's PTR Boosts. Live route: unpublished for 3.2.0; it exists in Season 14's general unique pool. Newly worth chasing on the PTR - its damage bonus doubled from 7.5-10%[x] to 15-20%[x], which moves it from a filler unique to a real amulet contender. Where →
  • SSplinter of Anguish jewelry socket New Soul Splinter socketable, jewelry only. PTR route: Mrak's PTR Boosts explicitly include Soul Splinters. Live route: unpublished. Anguish is the correct pick here and Splinter of Hellfire is disqualified: Hellfire's 40-100% increased damage costs 100% Critical Strike Chance, and this build's whole damage model is critical strikes on a piercing shot. Anguish's +30% Primary Resource cost is a real problem for a build Maxroll already calls Energy-starved - pair it with extra Energy Regeneration on pants and rings, and drop it if you start stalling mid-pull. Where →
  • Target-farm The Butcher, a Greater-tier Lair boss (1x Greater Lair Key) - the dedicated source for this item. Where →

Vulnerable

UpgradeSmoke Grenade

Enemies hit by Smoke Grenade become Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

Size

UpgradeSmoke Grenade

Smoke Grenade's size is increased by 25%.

Resolve

UpgradePoison Trap

Casting Poison Trap grants 2 stacks of Resolve.

Charges

UpgradePoison Trap

Poison Trap gains 1 Charge.

Knock Down

UpgradePoison Trap

Poison Trap Knocks Down enemies for 2 seconds when it activates.

Vulnerable

UpgradePoison Trap

Poison Trap makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds when it activates.

Healing

UpgradeDark Shroud

You Heal for 10% of your Maximum Life when a Dark Shroud shadow is consumed.

Critical Strike

UpgradeDark Shroud

While you have at least 1 active shadow from Dark Shroud, gain 5%[+] Critical Strike Chance.

Vulnerable

UpgradeShadow Imbuement

Shadow Imbued Skills and Shadow Imbuement makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

Duration

UpgradeShadow Imbuement

When Shadow Imbuement's infection expires, Shadow Imbuement's duration is increased by 0.5 seconds, up to 5 seconds.

Ferocity

UpgradeShadow Imbuement

When Shadow Imbuement's infection expires, you have a 25% chance to gain 1 stack of Ferocity.

Overpower

UpgradeShadow Imbuement

Casting Shadow Imbuement grants 2 stacks of Overpower.

Energy

UpgradePoison Imbuement

Casting Poison Imbuement generates 30 Energy, increased by 2 for each Nearby Poisoned enemy.

Critical Strike

UpgradePoison Imbuement

Critical Strikes with Poison Imbued Skills increase its Poisoning damage by 25%[x].

Overpower

UpgradeCold Imbuement

When you Freeze an enemy while Cold Imbued, gain 1 stack of Overpower.

Resolve

UpgradeCold Imbuement

When Cold Imbuement Chills an enemy, you have a 25% chance to gain 1 stack of Resolve.

Cooldown

UpgradeCold Imbuement

When Cold Imbuement Chills an enemy, Cold Imbuement's Cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds.

Energy

UpgradeCold Imbuement

Cold Imbued Skills grant 4 Energy when hitting an enemy for the first time.

Cooldown

UpgradeDeath Trap

Killing an enemy or dealing damage to an Elite for the first time with Death Trap reduces its Cooldown by 1 second.

Dodge

UpgradeDeath Trap

Casting Death Trap grants you 50% Dodge Chance for 4 seconds.

Resolve

UpgradeDeath Trap

Death Trap's damage is increased by 20%[x] while you have Resolve.

Weaken

UpgradeDeath Trap

Death Trap makes enemies Weakened for 6 seconds.

Resolve

UpgradeShadow Clone

Casting Shadow Clone grants 4 stacks of Resolve. While any Shadow Clone is active, you gain 1 Resolve per 1 second.

Unstoppable

UpgradeShadow Clone

Casting Shadow Clone grants Unstoppable for 4 seconds.

Cooldown

UpgradeRain of Arrows

Rain of Arrows' Cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

Double Damage

UpgradeRain of Arrows

Rain of Arrows deals 20%[x] increased damage and has a 25% chance to deal double damage.

Ferocity

UpgradeRain of Arrows

Rain of Arrows' damage is increased by 10%[x] for every stack of Ferocity you have when Casting Rain of Arrows.

Cast Speed and Lucky Hit

UpgradeRain of Arrows

Rain of Arrows' Cast Speed is increased by 50%[+] and Lucky Hit Chance is increased by 50%[x].
